title: Configuration with an added memory tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $K$ work tapes on input $x$, let $M\colon\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$ describe an additional tape, and let $p\in\mathbb Z$. The resulting configuration has $K+1$ work tapes: it preserves the state, input-head position, original work tapes and their head positions, and output of $c$, and uses $M$ and $p$ as the contents and head position of the added tape.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $K$ of original work tapes
